methodology.benchmark: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 plus current English model-page snapshots of output speed and TTFT. The Intelligence Index is a broad composite benchmark, not a universal definition of model quality; reasoning-effort variants are distinct configurations.
methodology.pricing: Use first-party standard API list prices in USD when the provider publishes them directly. Where a provider's public documentation does not expose a stable USD table, use Artificial Analysis's explicitly reported price for that model's first-party API and label that fallback in the source note. Tool/search/grounding charges, cache writes, volume discounts, batch pricing and premium service tiers are excluded. Announced future prices are encoded when available.
methodology.workload: Scenario cost uses editable input and output token counts: cost = input_tokens × input_rate / 1e6 + output_tokens × output_rate / 1e6. It does not estimate hidden reasoning-token usage unless the provider bills those tokens as output and they are present in the supplied output-token count.
methodology.frontier: A model is on the displayed price/intelligence frontier when no other scored model has both an equal-or-higher Intelligence Index and an equal-or-lower scenario cost, with at least one strict improvement.
methodology.comparability: Speed and TTFT are volatile point-in-time observations. The dataset uses the English Artificial Analysis model page as the consistent performance surface and records a snapshot date. Release coverage is broader than the chart: every newly reviewed release is either included or recorded with an explicit exclusion reason.
